xero_posting.description: Separate Stripe payout po_1T6MN2H67fTKgSywfxjbX2za; gross charge attribution unresolved

opening_boundary_chain.source_interpretation: The payout distributes a Stripe balance accumulated before the reconstruction period.

safe_next_xero_step.treatment: A distinct current-asset clearing account was created for the separate Stripe account, and only the source-matched 660.10 bank receipt was reconciled to it. No revenue was recognised.
safe_next_xero_step.remaining_balance: The account has a visible 660.10 credit balance until the upstream 687.50 charge and 27.40 of fees are posted.
safe_next_xero_step.reason_for_distinct_account: The two Stripe accounts' IDs, balances and payout chains must remain account-scoped. Reusing the now-zero Xero-linked Stripe Clearing account would collapse two unproven account relationships.

decision_gates.question: How should the unattributed 687.50 charge be classified?
decision_gates.required_evidence: Customer, invoice, booking or other source that identifies the sale; absent that, an explicit suspense/unidentified-income treatment decision.

decision_gates.question: Was the 1197.73 opening Stripe balance a YesMandarin business asset at 30 June 2025?
decision_gates.required_evidence: Owner confirmation or prior-period source tying the balance to YesMandarin.

non_decisions: The 1197.73 opening-boundary payout is not current-period income.
The separate Stripe account must not be merged into the Xero-linked account's clearing history.
